body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 4003493605e587fa4eac47aca481f2c10e9942bc -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge, after #1434 merges first.**

Stacked review: both commits read; built locally, trial-merged with current main (clean, no conflicts).

**What looks good**
- Commit 1, fb37cf265 (#1434, #1410): `doosan-dnm.mch` travel is the full catalog stroke each way in program coordinates (X +-1020, Y +-570, Z -510..510), as the travel rule in `assets/machines/AGENTS.md` asks. It is a figure from the catalog, nothing invented. Z 520 still refuses by name.
- Commit 2, 400349360 (#1433): a new 3-axis built-in with no A table, so no nose_to_axis is owed. The A-table file keeps its path and becomes "Doosan DNM 5700 + rotary table"; it still states no `nose_to_axis`, so the index-swing law still refuses every op on it by name. `posting_index_swing.rs` and the travel check are untouched; only a machine file, the `MACHINES` list and tests change. Nothing is loosened for a machine that has the rotary.
- Follows the Tormach 770MX / microARC precedent; decision files, site doc and Changelog line are present.

**Against old code (main's `doosan-dnm.mch` and `posting.rs`, the PR's tests kept)**
- `vmc_stroke`: 3 of 5 fail on main (`a_plate_contour_on_the_built_in_dnm_passes_the_stroke_and_posts`, `a_clearance_past_the_dnm_column_still_refuses_by_name`, `the_dnm_rotary_variant_still_refuses_an_unjudgeable_index_by_name`). The two others pass.
- `fourth_axis_pose`: 2 fail on main (the doosan dialect refusal tests, by library name).
- `machine::every_shipped_machine_mounts_and_speaks_its_declaration`: fails on main (list length).

**Results on the PR head merged with main (local, not the runner)**
- `camcraft-app`: vmc_stroke 5, machine 33, machine_library 11, fourth_axis_pose 9, doosan_dnm_a_state 2, index_swing 13, index_swing_horizontal 13, conformance 7, program_units 7: all pass.
- `camcraft-post`: doosan_dnm_post 9, probe_spindle_stop 2: pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --tests -- -D warnings`: clean.
- I did not run the full gate-mapped list (posting.rs maps to every app suite); the change there is two list entries.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- #1434 is still a draft and has no review; #1439 holds its commit, so #1434 must merge first, or this one carries both. Retarget as AGENTS.md says if #1434 is merged by itself.
- The UI machine picker was not driven by hand (the PR says so too). No holds or owed machine checks are recorded on either PR.
- A project saved on the old "Doosan DNM 5700" keeps its A table and still refuses until remounted; the PR documents this.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
